description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

description.zh:
IPv6网关的描述信息。

长度为0-256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The description of the IPv6 gateway.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
IPv6网关的名称。

长度为0-128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The name of the IPv6 gateway.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: IPv6网关的地域ID。您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en: The region ID of the IPv6 gateway. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
IPv6网关所属的资源组ID。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见[什么是资源组](~~2381067~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the IPv6 gateway belongs.

For more information about resource groups, see [What is a resource group?](~~2381067~~).

description.zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
The ID of the VPC for which you want to enable IPv6 and create the IPv6 gateway.

descriptions.zh:
- 创建IPv6网关之前，请确保目标VPC和交换机已开通IPv6网段能力，您可以调用[DescribeVpcAttribute](~~448582~~)，查询VPC的配置信息。

- 一个VPC内仅允许创建一个IPv6网关。

- **CreateIpv6Gateway**接口属于异步接口，即系统返回一个实例ID，但该IPv6网关尚未创建成功，系统后台的启动任务仍在进行。您可以调用[DescribeIpv6GatewayAttribute](~~102226~~)查询IPv6网关的创建状态：
    - 当IPv6网关处于**Creating**状态时，表示IPv6网关正在创建中。
    - 当IPv6网关处于**Created**状态时，表示IPv6网关创建完成。
- **CreateIpv6Gateway**接口不支持在同一个VPC下并发创建IPv6网关。
descriptions.en:
- Before you create an IPv6 gateway, make sure that the target VPC and vSwitch have IPv6 CIDR blocks enabled. You can call [DescribeVpcAttribute](~~448582~~) to query the configuration of a VPC.

- Only one IPv6 gateway can be created in a VPC.

- **CreateIpv6Gateway** is an asynchronous operation. After you send a request, the system returns an instance ID but enable IPv6 gateway is not yet created. The system continues to run the startup task in the background. You can call [DescribeIpv6GatewayAttribute](~~102226~~) to query the creation status of enable IPv6 gateway:
    - If enable IPv6 gateway is in the **Creating** state, enable IPv6 gateway is being created.
    - If enable IPv6 gateway is in the **Created** state, enable IPv6 gateway is created.
- The **CreateIpv6Gateway** operation does not support concurrent creation of IPv6 gateways in the same VPC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc create-ipv6-gateway --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-123sedrfswd230000 --name ipv6GW --description ipv6gatewayforVPC1 --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe637760 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazb4ph6aiy0000 --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --dry-run true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc CreateIpv6Gateway --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key FinanceDept --Description ipv6gatewayforVPC1 --VpcId 'vpc-123sedrfswd230000' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxazb4ph6aiy0000' --Tag.1.Value FinanceJoshua --DryRun true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe637760' --Name ipv6GW
